material_result: Small repeatable necessity signal: equal-norm perturbation of a decoded direction-coded recurrent subspace reduced all-gap interpolation robustness by about 0.5-0.74 percentage points relative to residual-subspace controls while clean accuracy remained approximately matched; no clear corresponding frame-dropout or off-manifold-contraction effect. Peer review additionally reveals unquantified author-side same-synthetic-pretraining controls for C3D/ViViT reported as similar or degraded transfer.
